purpose: Direct points forecasting; never derive a score from a win probability
historical_information_cutoff: Before midnight America/New_York on each game date; apply all same-date results only afterward
evaluation_disclosure: 2025-26 was previously inspected for winner-model evaluation and sign audits. Score results on it are exploratory chronological evaluation, not a new untouched holdout.
selection_metric: 2024-25 mean absolute error across both team scores
features: own prior offense relative to league times expected pace/100
opponent prior defense relative to league times expected pace/100
prior rest difference clipped to seven days /7
bounds: Own missing-production coefficient <=0; opponent coefficient >=0; other coefficients unconstrained
baseline: Unfitted rolling expected pace times mean of own smoothed offensive efficiency and opponent smoothed defensive efficiency /100
pace_proxy: Average of both box-score possession estimates FGA +0.44 FTA - OREB + TO, normalized to 48 minutes using recorded played minutes with a 48-minute minimum. Estimated possessions, not official tracking pace.
outputs: Separate direct team score predictions; nonnegative, round half up to integer for display and save those exact integers before cutoff
availability: Same rolling participation-production proxy as frozen winner model. Live official overrides are an unvalidated extension. No designation-specific probabilities invented.
overtime: Train/evaluate against final scores including overtime. Pace inputs normalized to regulation; no explicit overtime occurrence model.
future_validation: A later uninspected season is required before any new untouched-validation claim
